welcome.title: Welcome to the Training Hub!
welcome.body: Let's take a quick tour of the platform's main features. You can skip at any time.

dashboard.title: Your training
dashboard.body: Here you see every available learning track and course, with each one's status: not started, in progress, or completed.

curso.title: Inside a course
curso.body: Opening a course shows its downloadable materials and, when available, a practice quiz — it's just for reinforcing the content, with no passing score or attempt limit.

certificado.title: Complete and issue a certificate
certificado.body: After going through the content, click "Mark as completed". A PDF certificate becomes available for download immediately, with a validation code.

ranking.title: Points, achievements and ranking
ranking.body: You earn points by completing courses, tracks, and correct quiz answers, plus unlock achievements at milestones. Here you see your position on the overall ranking.

idioma.title: Language and your account
idioma.body: At the top of the screen you can switch language (Português, English, Español) and, from your name's menu, sign out.

relatorios.title: Team reports
relatorios.body: As a Team manager, you have access to Reports: track your team's progress, see who's overdue, and export the data as CSV.

admin.title: Administration area
admin.body: As an Administrator, you also have access to Administration: create courses, materials, quizzes, learning tracks, and manage each user's role (student, manager, or admin).
